title: Live improvement log
summary: Operator-ordered rolling log (2026-08-18): the orchestrator records improvement observations from live supervision over the coming hours. Every entry is reconciled against in-flight cards and existing dossiers before it may propose new work - dedup is the core discipline. Entries carry one of three verdicts: covered-by (existing key), operator-action (no ticket needed, a hand must move), or new-candidate (becomes a card only after a second sighting or operator nod).
statusReason: Normalized non-schema status/phase values ("accepted"/"in-progress") to the valid WorkbenchCatalogueService enum ("active"/"informational"): this is a perpetual rolling supervision log, not a decided-to-documented pipeline, so it has no terminal state and stays in the current list indefinitely. Log content last appended 2026-08-21 00:1x (unchanged; entries are append-only and were not rewritten). relatedTaskKeys reflect point-in-time references at the time each entry was written, not live delivery dependencies - several (AGT-2658, AGT-2655, AGT-2672) have since archived; the analysis cards AGT-2648 and AGT-2662 are also archived, but their respective dossiers (batch-gate-concept, rebase-merge-and-steering) remain decision-pending and are tracked separately in their own workbench entries; AGT-2663 and AGT-2664 are open coding cards actively in 3-progress as of 2026-08-23.
